key_insight: Instead of merely fitting observed decisions as optimal, the paper learns objective weights that make the model’s chosen solution outperform the observed action in every component.
engineering_relevance: This gives a practical way to train decision models for MILPs when logged actions are suboptimal, improving downstream decision quality rather than just imitation.
method: Define an outperformance inverse-optimization loss that can be evaluated using only forward-problem oracles.
Optimize the loss with gradient-based and DC (difference-of-convex) algorithms.
Prove a generalization bound for the probability of failing to outperform on new states.
evidence_signal: Experiments on synthetic and real data show the proposed methods improve prediction of solutions that outperform the observed actions over existing methods.
watch_item: The guarantee assumes weights induce a unique outperforming optimal solution at all training observations, so performance may depend on oracle quality and solution uniqueness in practice.
paper_title: Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions
